classification.meaning: intended effect happened (even if terminal persistence had failed); no duplicate write

classification.meaning: no effect proven; retry allowed only via newly bounded attempt with fresh lease

classification.condition: observed_raw_digest != candidate and != original (third raw state)
classification.meaning: semantic intervention required; no silent rebase/overwrite/merge

crash_recovery_matrix.next_action: Classify as FAILED_NO_EFFECT (mandatory ordering proves no external attempt occurred); retry only after revalidating authorization and all current preconditions; PREPARED read not required to prove no attempt but re-read before resume
Stranded APPLYING is outcome-uncertain; enter RECONCILING before any retry; read authority store; do not blindly retry (STRANDED_APPLYING_BLIND_RETRY_ALLOWED=no)

crash_recovery_matrix.point: external write returns known failure/no effect
crash_recovery_matrix.next_action: Persist FAILED_NO_EFFECT (authoritative rejection + unchanged raw identity); retry only via newly authorized bounded attempt after fresh preconditions

crash_recovery_matrix.point: external write succeeds but process dies before verify
crash_recovery_matrix.next_action: Future run observes nonterminal APPLYING → RECONCILING → read authority; exact candidate → VERIFIED_RECOVERED (J3/J10); no duplicate write

crash_recovery_matrix.point: external write times out / connection drops
crash_recovery_matrix.next_action: Persist OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; reconciliation must read authority before any retry; classify per three-way comparison
Persist VERIFIED_RECOVERED; no retry; success proven by exact candidate raw identity
If fresh auth + Subject + raw preconditions re-established → RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT; otherwise remain RECONCILING until they are; retry only via new bounded attempt
Persist CONFLICT; surface choices to LLM/user; no mechanical selection or overwrite
Resume deterministic reconciliation read; re-classify per three-way precedence (idempotent)
